June 16, 2018 - By wolcottdaily
Parnassus Investments increased its stake in Qualcomm Inc. (QCOM) by 17.92% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Parnassus Investments bought 1.49 million shares as the company’s stock declined 10.48% with the market. The institutional investor held 9.80 million shares of the radio and television broadcasting and communications equipment company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $543.02M, up from 8.31M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Parnassus Investments who had been investing in Qualcomm Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $88.75 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.67% or $0.4 during the last trading session, reaching $59.86. About 9.26 million shares traded.
